fields.Frequency: Per closure; ~29 staff redeployed (the 29-staff/store canon; balance separated per W2274)

workflows.name: Redeployed Employee Onboarding at New Location

Controls: - CTL-408 (ensure controlled execution — Staff Redeployment & Post-Closure Analytics (PA-59.3).)
- CTL-408 (employee-master update — links to VS-19 / W292); operational: CHRO sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adjustment-failure risk**: the redeployed employee doesn't adjust to the new store (longer commute, different culture) and resigns; mitigated by the 30-day check-in and the relocation/commute support

- **Receiving-store-disruption risk**: the influx of redeployed employees disrupts the receiving store's team dynamics; mitigated by the phased onboarding and the receiving-Store-Manager orientation plan
System Touchpoints: - HRIS (links to VS-19 / W15 onboarding, W292 employee master) — the transfer processing
- Nearby-store capacity (links to VS-19 / W34 shift scheduling) — the receiving-store staffing plan
- Relocation (links to VS-19 / W43 separation, VS-141 employee transport) — the relocation support
Time Estimate: ~5 days/closure × ~2.5/year + ~1 week adjustment = **~100 hours/year** HR + receiving Store Managers.

steps.activity: HR processes movement in system, updates location, arranges relocation support; receiving Store Manager plans orientation; 30-day check-in to assess adjustment

Automation Opportunity: - Migration auto-tracked from the loyalty-ID; retention auto-computed; non-migrated auto-flagged for re-engagement
Controls: - CTL-408 (ensure controlled execution — Staff Redeployment & Post-Closure Analytics (PA-59.3).)
- CTL-408 (customer-data privacy — links to VS-91 / W53); operational: VP Marketing monthly review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Migration-failure risk**: customers don't migrate to the nearest store (they go to a competitor instead); mitigated by the re-engagement campaigns and the welcome offer

- **Attribution-ambiguity risk**: a loyalty member's purchase at a nearby store may not be attributable to the closure (they were already shopping there); mitigated by the pre-closure-shop-pattern baseline
System Touchpoints: - CRM/CDP (links to VS-13 / W156 CDP, VS-126) — the customer-migration tracking
- Marketing (links to VS-14 / W83 campaign) — the re-engagement campaigns
- Analytics (links to VS-27 / W113) — the retention and spend-change computation

steps.activity: System tracks: loyalty members from closed store → purchases at nearby stores; calculates retention and spend change; re-engagement campaigns for non-migrated customers

Automation Opportunity: - Actual-vs-estimate auto-compared; payback auto-computed; network-P&L auto-assembled
Controls: - CTL-408 (ensure controlled execution — Staff Redeployment & Post-Closure Analytics (PA-59.3).)
- CTL-408 (financial-impact accuracy — links to VS-17); operational: CEO quarterly review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Savings-non-realization risk**: the projected savings don't materialize (nearby stores' costs increase from absorbing the volume); mitigated by the network-P&L view (not just the closed-store P&L)

- **Estimate-vs-actual-divergence risk**: the original business-case estimates were wrong, undermining future closure decisions; mitigated by the estimate-vs-actual reconciliation feeding the next closure model
System Touchpoints: - FP&A (links to VS-17 / W26 budget, VS-59 / W2263 business case) — the actual-vs-estimate comparison
- Nearby-store P&L (links to VS-17 / W67 store performance) — the surrounding-store impact
- Analytics (links to VS-27 / W113) — the payback computation

steps.activity: Compares actual costs vs. estimates; tracks quarterly savings vs. projected; calculates actual payback; reviews surrounding store impact; validates network P&L

Automation Opportunity: - Knowledge-base auto-assembled from the project documents; cross-referenced to VS-37 new-store-opening
Controls: - CTL-51: knowledge-base data quality; operational: COO sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Knowledge-loss risk**: the closure-experience is in the PM's head, not in a retrievable system; mitigated by the documented knowledge base
- **Inaccessible-knowledge risk**: the knowledge base exists but future teams don't know to look for it; mitigated by the closure-playbook reference at project kickoff (W2266)
System Touchpoints: - Knowledge management (links to VS-30 / W381, VS-88 / W255) — the closure knowledge base
- VS-37 (links to VS-37 / W16 new-store opening) — the cross-reference for new openings
- Document retention (links to VS-88 / W256) — the 10-year archive

steps.activity: Compiles: business case, plan, timeline, actual costs, lessons learned, contacts, filings; stores in knowledge management system; accessible for future closures and new store openings (VS-37)

Controls: - CTL-408 (ensure controlled execution — Staff Redeployment & Post-Closure Analytics (PA-59.3).)
- Operational: VP Store Operations sign-off on defensive actions
Pain Points / Risks: - **Competitor-opportunity risk**: a competitor opens in the vacated trade area, capturing the demand BuildRight expected to absorb at nearby stores; mitigated by the defensive-action recommendation (aggressive nearby-store investment, targeted customer retention)

- **Attribution-confound risk**: the regional sales change is confounded by a market shift (a recession, a new entrant) unrelated to the closure; mitigated by the controlled-comparison (market-level baseline)
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113, VS-33 / competitive intelligence) — the regional sales assessment
- Competitor monitoring (links to VS-57 / W2214 competitor price intelligence) — the competitor-activity data
- Store-performance (links to VS-07 / W67) — the nearby-store performance data

steps.activity: Assesses: total regional sales pre vs. post, market share change, competitor activity; identifies if closure created competitor opportunity; recommends defensive actions

Controls: - CTL-408 (ensure controlled execution — Staff Redeployment & Post-Closure Analytics (PA-59.3).)
- Operational: CHRO sign-off on the metrics and policy updates
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-response-rate risk**: the survey gets few responses (redeployed employees are busy at the new store); mitigated by the incentive and the manager-encouraged participation

- **Retention-decline-blindness risk**: redeployed employees resign at a higher rate than baseline, but the pattern isn't detected; mitigated by the redeployed-cohort retention metric alongside the store-level metric
System Touchpoints: - HR analytics (links to VS-19 / HR-028 engagement survey, VS-103 people analytics) — the survey and retention data
- Performance (links to VS-19 / W72 employee performance) — the post-redeployment performance
- HR policy (links to VS-19 / W15 onboarding, W34 scheduling) — the updated policies

steps.activity: Surveys: satisfaction, performance, commute, retention at 6 and 12 months; identifies best practices; updates HR policies

fields.Participants: VP Store Operations, FP&A Director, CEO

Controls: - CTL-349: board & ExComm governance — network-plan sign-off minuted (links to VS-36); operational: CEO/ExComm sign-off on the network plan
Pain Points / Risks: - **Network-optimization-as-shrinkage risk**: the analysis recommends closures to optimize the network, but the market interprets it as BuildRight retreating (brand-damage); mitigated by the paired-growth-narrative (for every closure, a new-opening or a nearby-store-investment)
- **Closure-trigger-inertia risk**: the network analysis identifies candidates but no action follows (ExComm defers); mitigated by the decision-deadline tied to the annual-plan cycle
System Touchpoints: - Store-performance (links to VS-07 / W67, VS-177 field-retail analytics) — the full-network performance
- Network optimization (links to VS-33 / strategic planning, VS-136 supply-chain network design) — the network-modeling
- Site selection (links to VS-20 / W116 site selection) — the new-opportunity evaluation
Time Estimate: ~7.5 days/year + ~4 days modeling = **~90 hours/year** VP Store Operations + FP&A.

steps.activity: Reviews all store performance, identifies future closure candidates, evaluates new opportunities in vacated areas; FP&A models scenarios; optimal network plan to Executive Committee

Automation Opportunity: - Playbook-change-diff auto-generated from the lessons-learned; regulatory-change auto-checked for playbook impact
Controls: - CTL-408 (ensure controlled execution — Staff Redeployment & Post-Closure Analytics (PA-59.3).)
- Operational: COO sign-off on the annual update
Pain Points / Risks: - **Playbook-staleness risk**: the playbook isn't updated (a regulatory change or a cost-benchmark shift is missed); mitigated by the annual refresh trigger
- **Playbook-as-shelfware risk**: the playbook exists but isn't consulted at the next closure; mitigated by the playbook-reference at project kickoff (W2266)
System Touchpoints: - Knowledge/playbook (links to VS-30 / W381, VS-88 / W255, VS-59 / W2281) — the versioned playbook
- Lessons learned (links to VS-59 / W2277) — the post-closure input
- Distribution (links to VS-07 / W571) — the playbook distribution to Regional Ops

steps.activity: Updates playbook: process improvements, new regulations, cost benchmarks, contacts; COO reviews and approves; distributes to Regional Ops and COO
